mapper.select: SELECT qtype, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE correct) AS correct, round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE correct)::numeric / count(*), 4) AS accuracy FROM app.eval_result WHERE run_id = #{runId} GROUP BY qtype ORDER BY min(question_id)

SELECT coalesce(error_type, 'UNCLASSIFIED') AS error_type, count(*) AS cnt FROM app.eval_result WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND NOT correct GROUP BY coalesce(error_type, 'UNCLASSIFIED') ORDER BY cnt DESC, error_type

SELECT coalesce(route, 'none') AS route, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE correct) AS correct FROM app.eval_result WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.eval_result routed WHERE routed.run_id = #{runId} AND routed.route IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY coalesce(route, 'none') ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['tool', 'sql', 'clarify', 'refuse', 'none'], coalesce(route, 'none'))
